note: Both arms read one tree at one path -- the MCP arm's servers read the image's own /data in the run's container, and the mirage /data mount is a copy of it taken out of the same image. The repositories under repos/ are the clones upstream's image makes, at upstream's commits. The calendar is the Google Workspace fake both arms read, seeded per run from Atlas's export.

cases.name: fetch
cases.why: the fetch CLI is the MCP arm's fetch server, reading the same page live

cases.name: git_log
cases.why: the local clone has the same history on both arms, which is where the second commit is counted

cases.name: git_show
cases.why: the second commit touches the same file on both arms

cases.name: git_status
cases.why: both arms find the clone detached at upstream's commit

cases.name: list_events
cases.why: both arms find the same events on July 15, 2025, New York time
